source.name: Sector weights from each fund's Form 10-Q, quarter ended June 30, 2026 (as shown on the map)

method: A theme is a set of the sector names each fund's own filing uses. Weights are those sectors' published shares of the fund. Tagging is this tool's judgment; a sector is tagged only where the filing's own label says what it is.

themes.label: AI & data centers
themes.description: Buildings, power and networks that run cloud computing and AI.

themes.label: Software & tech services
themes.description: Companies that sell software or technology services. AI can help them or compete with them.

themes.label: Housing
themes.description: Apartments, single-family rentals and other places people rent to live.

themes.label: Logistics & transport
themes.description: Warehouses, ports, rail, roads and the networks that move goods.

themes.label: Energy & power
themes.description: Producing, moving and storing energy, from pipelines to power generation.

themes.label: Healthcare
themes.description: Providers, services and technology for health care.
